title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 9  An Act Amending Section thirteen of Presidential Decree Numbered Ninety-Seven Regulating the Practice of the Marine Profession in the Philippines, By Prescribing a Uniform "Unlimited" License for All Deck Officers Except Patrons.

text.en:
Section thirteen of Presidential Decree Numbered Ninety-seven is hereby amended to read as
"Sec. 13. The Licenses for Deck Officers shall be classified as:
"(a) Unlimited competency to command and/or navigate merchant marine vessels of any gross tons, upon the
waters of any sea or ocean.
"(b) Restricted (Major) competency to command and/or navigate merchant marine vessels of not more than
two hundred fifty gross tons in a particular water of the Philippines.
"(c) Restricted (bay, lake, river or harbor) competency to command and/or navigate vessels of not more than
twenty gross tons in a particular bay, lake, river or harbor in the Philippines."
